description: Driven by a passion for space exploration and hands-on tinkering, we are tackling the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge. Our goal is to design an immersive experience that introduces young minds to space mission fundamentals. By combining problem-solving, science, and creative adventure, we are building an exciting platform to inspire tomorrow's pioneers!
summary: The Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer project, developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, is an interactive 2D educational astronaut training simulator designed to engage and inspire young space enthusiasts. Built on the Godot Engine using custom GDScript player controllers, the game features smooth side-scrolling movement, modular scene architecture, and responsive collision handling. Visually defined by retro 5-frame cartoon walking sprite sheets, the trainer blends classic arcade charm with realistic astronaut preparation tasks, challenging players through interactive zero-gravity maneuvers, equipment repair mini-games, and mission-based puzzles.
